about: The technology: runtimes, frameworks, libraries, the test and quality gates, and where each is used.

runtime.name: Node.js + TypeScript (tsx)
runtime.role: every CLI (npm run <verb> is tsx src/modules/<module>/cli.ts); typecheck tsc --noEmit and astro check

runtime.name: Node ESM scripts (.mjs)
runtime.role: the store's writers: watcher, record, record-sources, merge-claims (thin wrappers over the watcher checkout)

runtime.name: ffmpeg (FFMPEG_DIR, Remotion's bundled build)
runtime.role: chunk render, mux; the mix itself is PCM in src/modules/video/mix.ts because that ffmpeg has no afade, aloop or limiter

runtime.name: Git
runtime.role: the state store: artifacts committed, decisions carry a sha; the tree guard snapshots and reverts

site.name: Astro 7
site.role: the static site (build-time rendering), the dev-only admin pages injected when command === 'dev', redirects from moved.json, sitemap

site.name: Tailwind CSS 4 (@tailwindcss/vite)
site.role: styles; brand faces self-hosted from brand/fonts/

site.name: Content graph (src/modules/website/content-graph.ts)
site.role: every URL from a node id (urlOf), derived each build, never stored; public-urls.json freezes them

site.name: Client JS
site.role: kept to the tab bar, claim search, video facade, board copy/sort/filter, review page seek/notes/job refresh, the calculators in src/tools/

video.name: Remotion 4 + React 19
video.role: the renderer: Video.tsx, scenes in remotion/scenes (COMPONENTS), bespoke graphics per video, Portrait.tsx for Shorts; browser-safe files import no node:*

video.name: kinds.ts
video.role: the closed map from storyboard scene to component (KindSpec); an unsupported scene fails the build

video.name: theme.ts
video.role: the one home of colour: the owning institution's kit fills its roles; no literal colour in a component

video.name: SceneView fit guard
video.role: checks every rendered frame: visible text that leaves the frame or runs into the citation fails the render

video.name: componentVersion
video.role: the chunk cache key and each bespoke graphic's approval key: a hash of normalised sources read from the TypeScript AST

video.name: edge-tts (draft), Azure AI Speech SDK (release), OpenAI (optional)
video.role: narration with word timings; cues name narration words

video.name: PCM mixer (mix.ts, assemble.ts)
video.role: narration track, soundtrack cues over scene anchors, peak under the ceiling by turning the music down, never the narration

video.name: Strudel bench
video.role: generative compositions imported as WAV (never committed), licence cleared by a person

automation.name: Claude Code CLI (claude -p)
automation.role: every agent step under a per-role grant; the attempt record is the unit of spend

automation.name: nodemailer (SMTP 465)
automation.role: the outbox: halt mails, digest, requests, batches, launch mail

automation.name: imapflow + mailparser (IMAP 993)
automation.role: the inbox adapter: replies applied once through the CLIs

automation.name: Windows scheduled tasks
automation.role: the tick and the work plane; a person creates them from schedule --print

quality.name: vitest (unit project)
quality.role: npm test: boundaries, production, evidence, publishing, mail (FakeMail), web-quality, dist walk, accounts, docs, fixture topic

quality.name: vitest (browser project) + Playwright
quality.role: npm run test:browser: the site suite (reflow 320-1440, keyboard, axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA, lab CLS, reduced motion) and the admin live test; Chromium locally, three engines in CI

quality.name: html-validate, axe-core
quality.role: markup and accessibility in the web-quality gate (npm run quality: RESULT: PASSED)

quality.name: tests/boundaries.test.ts (compiler-backed)
quality.role: the module boundary: capabilities, readApi, browserSafe, layoutOwner; the edges allowlist is empty

quality.name: eslint 10 + typescript-eslint, prettier 3 (astro, tailwind plugins)
quality.role: npm run check (incremental), npm run validate (what CI runs: typecheck, lint, format, build, tests)

quality.name: npm run rehearse, docs/superpowers/plans/e2e.cjs
quality.role: a go-live in a throwaway copy; the e2e rehearsal once per phase candidate

verificationPolicy: change-driven: focused tests and npm run check per task; npm run validate, the boundary test and the e2e rehearsal once on the final candidate of a phase or branch, never again after a fast-forward merge; /produce and the runner still validate before an automated commit
